correctness.rationale: All steps are symbolic for arbitrary p>=5: gradient-product smoothness in characteristics zero and p; projective fixed equalizer on X0=1; exponent permutation reducing F to Phi_p; finite-flat cyclotomic quotient; Eisenstein uniformizer and residue nilpotence; one-block p-cycle representation and its p-2 tangent quotient. The standalone program checks six sample primes without substituting experiments for the proof.

Related published mathematical-record summaries and accessible prior calculations concern different automorphism data, singularity loci, or Hessian schemes; no direct implication was identified. The claim remains qualified against uninspected specialist literature.

value.rationale: A natural infinite family of smooth Klein cubic hypersurfaces displays an exact wild fixed-point collision. The result simultaneously identifies the full fixed scheme over Z_(p), its totally ramified cyclotomic local model, the curvilinear special length p-1, and the induced unipotent tangent type. This gives a structural boundary between tame eigenspace fixed points and wild characteristic-p fixed schemes rather than an arbitrary or isolated count.
